title: Wow, Sabastian Sawe set a world record with a 1:59:30...
content: Wow, Sabastian Sawe set a world record with a 1:59:30 marathon. “They call Sabastian Sawe the silent assassin. But it was impossible to ignore the beautiful destruction on the streets of London as the 30-year-old Kenyan…”
author: Jason Kottke
